inspector.title: Hippocampal T2 MRI: two manual source annotations
inspector.modality: Prepared-mean T2 MRI, separate manual annotations and exact source-cell boundaries
inspector.caption: Inspect the supplied high-resolution T2 mean and two manual hippocampal annotation sets from one healthy-adult research participant. All native planes, components and label-cell boundaries are retained. Compare rater differences without treating either annotation as anatomical truth. Annotations are tied to the prepared mean; raw repetitions remain separate image-only views. This does not establish diagnosis, normal-volume thresholds or complete reporting anatomy.
inspector.attribution:
Clark, Ian A.; Maguire, Eleanor A. (2023). Release of cognitive and multimodal MRI data including real-world tasks and hippocampal subfield segmentations. Dryad version7, DOI10.5061/dryad.2v6wwpzt3. Source publication: Scientific Data10:540, DOI10.1038/s41597-023-02449-9. CC0-1.0.

Selected source: Main Sample participant10 and DICE participant10. Primer adaptations: lossless native-plane transport, separate manual label schematics and complete source voxel-cell boundaries. No additional source resampling, smoothing or component deletion. The prepared mean retains its original intensity scale. Both annotation folders contain identical reference-image bytes. Annotations belong to the prepared mean; raw-repetition anatomical registration is unverified. Files0009 and0010 are byte-identical.

These are research source annotations, not histological truth, a normal-population standard, a current-patient registration or complete clinical reporting coverage. Source combined labels remain combined. The source Cyst category appears only in the reliability annotation and is not independently diagnosed here.

before.title: MRI and limbic source anatomy
before.instructions: Compare the original SPL atlas MRI, label-cell boundaries and publisher surfaces with the separate registered HippUnfold reference. Each source retains its own grid, labels and limits; neither is a patient-specific reconstruction or a normal-volume standard.

after.title: MRI and limbic source anatomy
after.instructions: Inspect the SPL atlas, registered HippUnfold reference and separate healthy-adult hippocampal study in their own coordinates. Compare both manual hippocampal annotations on their shared prepared mean. Raw repetitions are image-only views with unverified anatomical registration. Source annotations are not a normal-volume standard or a current-patient reconstruction.
